name: channel-logo
prompt: Create an original premium SQUARE YouTube channel profile logo for 'Vice City Alibis', an unofficial GTA VI fan-fiction crime-story channel. A bold, beautifully designed interlocking VCA monogram, all three letters clearly legible, inside a simple near-black plum circular badge on matching near-black square background. Geometric custom sans-serif letterforms, mostly warm ivory, with a restrained neon magenta left edge and teal right edge suggesting tropical nightlife. One tiny, simple palm silhouette can sit above the monogram, not obscuring any letters. The monogram fills most of the safe central circle and remains readable at 98 pixels. Do NOT copy Rockstar or Grand Theft Auto logos, no five-point star, no existing brand marks. Exact monogram text only: VCA. Centered, balanced, generous outer safe padding. 1:1 aspect.
